name: Append Block to Parent
description: Append new and/or existing blocks to the specified parent. [See the documentation](https://developers.notion.com/reference/patch-block-children)

configurable_props.name: pageId
configurable_props.label: Parent Block ID
configurable_props.description: Select a parent block/page or provide its ID

configurable_props.name: blockTypes
configurable_props.label: Block Type(s)
configurable_props.description: Select which type(s) of block you'd like to append

options.label: Provide Markdown content to create new blocks with
Provide Image URLs to create new image blocks

configurable_props.name: blockIds
configurable_props.label: Existing Block IDs
configurable_props.description: Select one or more block(s) or page(s) to append (selecting a page appends its children). You can also provide block or page IDs.

configurable_props.name: markdownContents
configurable_props.label: Markdown Contents
configurable_props.description: Each entry is the content of a new block to append, using Markdown syntax. [See the documentation](https://www.notion.com/help/writing-and-editing-basics#markdown-and-shortcuts) for more information

configurable_props.name: imageUrls
configurable_props.label: Image URLs
configurable_props.description: One or more Image URLs to append new image blocks with. [See the documentation](https://www.notion.com/help/images-files-and-media#media-block-types) for more information
